question: What claim is made about the totality of fields by referring to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs together?
premises: Together they relate to the whole group of fields.
inference: The whole group of fields belongs to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs together.
uncertainties: The internal structure of that field group is not specified here.
plain_english: The whole group of fields belongs to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
